title: Crazy Gopalan
desc: Gopalan, a notorious thief, teams up with Lakshmanan and continues to rob people. Their lives change when they kidnap a rich girl and find themselves trapped.

title: Chess
desc: A man murders his rich brother-in-law with the help of three co-conspirators to amass his wealth. He also manages to discredit the deceased man's illegitimate son.

title: Magic Oven
desc: A renowned chef shares and demonstrates the method to prepare various delicious recipes that can be easily made at home.

title: The Door
desc: Mithra, an architect, demolishes an old site to construct a new building. However, her actions end up releasing a paranormal entity into her life.

title: Ace
desc: Kannan's hope to start a new life abroad is cut short when he gets mixed up with dangerous people. He must outwit fate itself to escape the predicament he is in.

title: Echo
desc: Desperation sets in when Prakash's failing marriage is threatened by something otherworldly, prompting him to resort to black magic. He soon uncovers shocking family revelations.
